note: Machine-readable source for README.md. Release data checked via GitHub/Forgejo APIs on 2026-11-05. Game associations marked 'community-reported' come from the community update of the same date, not from upstream docs.

forks.name: Eglantine (Djihads80)
forks.notes: Derived from Eden, Yuzu and Sudachi; started by Camille LaVey. Daily builds and v0.1.0-rc1. Build 135 added NUP metadata, 168 rumble, 189 DLSS/Streamline. Stability varies: 196 last stable for one tester, 202-212 regressions for another, 212 works after rebuild. Build 202 was the Hyrule Warriors fix set.

forks.name: Eglantine (SmileyTatsu)
forks.notes: Fork of Djihads80. Pipeline-cache changes, guest RAM release, MKW frame-rate fix; not all merged upstream. README also points to upstream downloads.

forks.name: Orchid (MythosOfs)
forks.notes: Independent offshoot of Eglantine. Ampere shader lowerings, Switch 2 font handling, kernel thread-race and graphics fixes. Performance measured on 5800X3D + RX 9070 XT with Mesa RADV git. PGO Windows/Linux builds available.

forks.name: PokeDinner (Franseven)
forks.notes: 2.7.7 is Windows-only and explicitly experimental/broken. 1.x/2.0.0 tags include Linux AppImage and macOS arm64. Asks for 12 GB DRAM and a 32 GB pagefile/swap. Fire Emblem Fortune's Weave support is initial, not ready. Compatibility fixes, not the default Donkey Kong Bananza performance pick; ZendNevs documents better DK speed.

forks.name: Eglantine (notsapinho)
forks.notes: Every push to main is published. x86_64 builds require AVX2 (Haswell+ / Ryzen). Pokopia listed as playable.

forks.name: Lichii (zortos293)
forks.notes: Build-80 is a GitHub Actions artifact (commit 7459f10); Releases lag at build-75. Windows x86_64 PGO/non-PGO, Linux x86_64/aarch64, macOS arm64. Non-PGO avoids a black-screen issue reported with PGO. OoT field reports: 54-60 FPS on 9800X3D, 20-24 on i3-10100/RTX 3060; pattern suggests a single-core CPU bottleneck. 60 FPS clips are area-specific, flicker can make them unplayable, and NVIDIA alone is not a guarantee. Handles Switch 1 and Switch 2 titles; README does not publish a title list.

forks.name: Droplet
forks.notes: Modified eden-nx2 with Eglantine and PokeDinner work. Reservoir server branch adds a private NPLN replacement for MKW and Splatoon Raiders (friend codes, matchmaking, rooms, events) with Docker Compose. No keys or encrypted formats; decrypted folders, NRO/NSO/KIP only. v0.1.2 tag has no binary release; v0.1.1 binaries are marked old/outdated. P2P play exposes player IPs (per announcement); online CameraPlay unsupported; Splatoon sky bug; NUP archives slower.

forks.name: Eglantine nx2-merged (rdenno)
forks.notes: Fork of Djihads80 with its own nx2-merged builds. Hyrule Warriors fixes also exist upstream from build 202 onward.

forks.name: eden-nx2-android (moceure)
forks.notes: Maintained Android NX2 build found at check time. Desktop parity not expected; thermal throttling dominates long sessions.

forks.name: Selevet Eglantine
forks.notes: Unofficial Eglantine build tuned for Zen 3 with PGO, ThinLTO and faster GPU mapping.

forks.name: Eglantine ZendNevs
forks.notes: Merges Eglantine build-104, PokeDinner and Selevet Eglantine into one build (three codebases, not three executables). FSR 3/LSFG frame generation, DynamicFPS and a 30 FPS lock. v2.0.5 documents MKW at about 56 FPS average and 44-50 in the lowest 10% on a 5500X3D and RTX 4070 with 16 GB, DK Bananza at about 33 FPS average and 20.6 low with 99% game speed, and Pokopia startup at 60 FPS. DK still has hitches up to 0.6 s. No license declared at check time.

forks.name: EglantinePS5 (heydemoura)
forks.notes: Experimental Switch 2 emulator port for PS5. Check the repo's releases for current binaries.

forks.name: Eglantine 3060Ti 16GB
forks.notes: Named for one specific GPU. No independent verification of benefits.
